result:
I've implemented round 38 (TM-B40, D-45). The full `verifyCommand` exits 0, and the end-to-end tests (E2E) pass 7/7, also with `--retries=0`. Whether keyboard focus is now kept has not been checked in the real app yet: jsdom never drops focus, so only C's old-vs-new run (R38-4) can prove the fix. I mark no acceptance as passed.

**What changed (only the 8 owned paths):**
- **Code:** `SchemaEditor.tsx`, `MetadataPanel.tsx` and `ui/button.tsx` now match B's `prototype-src.diff` line for line (`diff` empty).
  - Done and Save Tags / `Save to N files` use `aria-disabled` and `aria-busy` instead of native `disabled`.
  - Clicking either button while it is unavailable does nothing.
  - A reorder arrow gets its own dim only at the edge of the list.
- **Tests:**
  - The new `busy-buttons-focus.test.ts` is an exact copy of B's draft, tests (f1)–(f8).
  - The 12 assertions in `metadata-panel-batch-save.test.ts` and `schema-editor-done-busy.test.ts` now check `aria-disabled`, and (b7) has the new line after 294.
- **Docs:**
  - `docs/bugs/001` has the updated header, new D-44 and D-45 bullets, one sentence added to entry 18, and the new entry 21.
  - In entry 20, the only missing function name was `handleClick` for `FileList.tsx:68`; the others were already there on `ea4a1cb`.
  - The README row now reads 21 entries / 12 fixed / 5 Saba questions, and I recounted it.

**Test results:**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Red, new tests on `ea4a1cb` src (before the fix) | 30 failed / 274 passed of 304, same as B; (f1) and (f3)–(f8) fail on the attribute or class, (f2) passes |
| Renderer, after the fix | 304/304, twice; each changed file also passes alone |
| New tests, time each | 15–97 ms |
| Biome | 0 errors, 8 warnings, same list as round 35 |
| Typecheck | 0 errors |
| Main | 93/93 |
| `verifyCommand` from a clean state | exit 0 |
| E2E | 7/7, also with `--retries=0` |

**Code review:** the `code-reviewer` subagent found no defects. It raised two low notes that I left as they are: hover styling still shows on an `aria-disabled` button, the same as native `disabled` today; and edge arrows sit at 18 % while Done is running, which is the planned design. It also noted that the (b1) test name still says "is disabled". I didn't rename it because the task forbids name changes, so it is a candidate for TM-B41.

**Not run by me:** the mutant runs (R38-3) and the real-app checks (R38-4, focus plus the ffprobe and music-metadata file checks); both are C's. Windows packaging is BLOCKED because it is not available in the cloud. RR-R35-02 (a timeout for an `onSave` that never finishes) is still an open question for Saba.
